The '''Quadanium Refinery''' was a structure owned by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Serres Sarrano]]. It produced large amounts of [[Quadanium steel/Legends|quadanium steel]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], much of which was used to build the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
